chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin i zaksa thu pan i pialkhiatkhak loh nadingin tua thu nakpitak i kinbawl ding kisam hi.
A hang pen vanmite' hong genkhiat thu a kip hi a, palsatna ahihkeileh thumanlohna khempeuh in amau tawh a kituak gawtthukna thuak uh ahih nungsang
tua zahin a thupi hotkhiatna thu thudon kei lehang eite bangci suahtak theih ding i hi hiam? Tua thu pen a masa-in Topa in genkhia a, tua thu a zate in eite' tungah kiptak hong gencian uh hi.
Pasian in zong kihilna lim lamdangte leh nalamdangte tawh ahi zongin, ama' deihna bangin a kihawm Kha Siangtho tawh ahi zongin, teci panbeh hi.
A hang pen Pasian in tu-a i gen, hong tung ding leitung pen vanmite' khutnuai ah koih lo hi.
Tua thu, mun khat ah hih bangin kiciantakin kigen hi: “Nangma' phawk tham dingin mihing bang hi lel a, nangma' thudon dingin mihing' tapa bang hi lel ahi hiam?
Tawmvei sung vanmite sangin a niamzaw dingin na bawl a, minpha leh pahtawina na khusak khinta hi.

Na khempeuh ama' uk dingin a khe nuai-ah na koihsak hi.” Ama' uk dingin na khempeuh a khe nuai-ah koihsak cih ciangin ama' ukna pualam ah bangmah om nawnlo hi. Tu tadih na khempeuh ama' ukna sungah a omlam i mu naikei hi.

Ahi zongin tawmvei sung vanmite sangin a niamzaw dinga kikoih Jesu i mu a, amah pen Pasian' hehpihna tawh mi khempeuh' taangin sihna a tuak ahih theih nadingin sihna tawh kisai gimthuakna hanga kingah minpha leh pahtawina lukhu kikhusak hi.

Na khempeuh ama' ading leh ama' hanga om ahih mah bangin Pasian in ta tampite minphatna sung a tunpihna ah tua tate' ading hotkhiatna thu a phuangkhia Jesu pen gimthuakna tungtawnin a cingtaak a suahsak ding a kilawm thu ahi hi.
A hang pen a siansuahpa leh a kisiansuah mite a vekun phung khat ahi uh hi. Tua mite sanggam cih ding a maizumlohna zong tua thu hang mah hi a,
amah in hih bangin ci hi: “Ka sanggamte' kiangah nangma' min ka pulak ding a, kikhawm mipite' laizang ah biakpiak la kong sak ding hi.”
Hih bangin zong ci hi: “Ama' sungah ka lungmuang ding hi.” Hih bangin ci lai hi: “En un, hih lai-ah keimah leh Pasian' hong piak naupangte ka om uh hi.”
Tua hi a, naupangte in si leh sa nei uh ahih mah bangin Jesu Khris in zong tua bangin a nei hi a, tua pen sihna vanglian a neipa, dawimangpa, sihna tungtawnin a suksiat theih nading, leh
sihna kihtak huhau-in khantawn sal suahna nuai-a om mite a khahkhiat theih nading, ahi hi.
A taktakin ama' lunghihmawh pen vanmite hilo a, Abraham' suanlekhakte hizaw hi.

Tua hangin amah pen Pasian tawh kisai thute ah a thukhual leh a muanhuai siampi lianpenpa suakin mawhnei mihingte' adingin mawhphelna a bawl ahih theih nadingin na khempeuh ah a sanggamte tawh a kibangin bawl a kul ahi hi.
A hang pen amahmah siatzolna tuakin gimna thuak ahih mah bangin siatzolna a tuak mite zong amah in honkhia thei hi.
